f-ip-63500346.reason: The redline substantially achieves the customer-ownership position, including a present assignment, Customer Data ownership, the required embedded-IP license attributes, and no joint ownership. f-warranty-addbb3a2.reason: The operative addition satisfies every preferred requirement, including the longer warranty periods, and therefore also satisfies the fallback durations.
